text:
sara-partnerships: FYI — Customer PO #98012345 got rejected by the AcmeCloud marketplace portal during ingest. Portal error says accept_window/ack mismatch. Trying to escalate, but wanted to loop you all in :eyes:

nick-ops: Ugh. Seen variants of this before. Can you paste the raw error?

sara-partnerships: Error payload from vendor-portal: `{
  "po_id": "98012345",
  "status": "rejected",
  "error": "accept_window_out_of_range: ack_ts 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z outside vendor_window 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z"
}`

jeff-sales: Customer is in PST, partner procurement in CET. They submitted PO in their local time and portal validation treats ack window as UTC. Client is pretty urgent — startup re: launch next week.

maria-legal: Any contract redlines causing additional validation? Or just portal schema/time handling?

sara-partnerships: Looks like pure validation bug. No redline. Portal has strict accept_window validation, and the partner's portal clock is interpreting ack_ts per vendor local tz.

vendor-portal-bot: Automated note: We received PO 98012345 and responded with rejection code 422. See ticket VP-4498.

nick-ops: Quick workaround: re-issue PO with ack_ts normalized to UTC (append Z) or massage accept_window to a 48h window so it passes. Which is faster?

sara-partnerships: Customer can reissue but they don't want to re-sign. Partner can relax window, but needs internal approval. I'm pinging their procurement lead now.

maria-legal: If partner relaxes window, confirm it doesn't change payment/commencement dates. We can sign off on temporary accept_window_relaxation flag for ingestion only. Need a short email trail.

jeff-sales: I'm drafting an email to partner ops to request the flag. Would help if eng can confirm safe to accept a looser window on our side.

nick-ops: From infra POV, accepting a wider window is fine for ingestion layer; we log original timestamps and surface mismatch in console. No backend risk. Recommend temporary toggle + follow-up fix.

sara-partnerships: Partner ops replied: "we can enable accept_window_relaxation=1 for AcmeCloud account. Will take ~3hrs to deploy to staging and 6hrs to production."

jeff-sales: Customer OK with 6hr fix if that unblocks launch — they asked for confirmation by EOD.

maria-legal: I drafted a one-paragraph ack email to both parties that captures no-change-to-terms and temporary nature. Sending now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for partner-config/accept_window_relaxation on staging (deploy-4821). ETA 3h.

nick-ops: When staging is up, we can re-run the PO ingest flow to confirm acceptance. Sara, can you hold the PO payload?

sara-partnerships: Holding. I'll re-trigger once deploy-bot reports success.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded (deploy-4821). Production deploy scheduled in 3h.

sara-partnerships: Re-triggered ingest on staging — portal accepted PO on staging. :thumbsup: Partner will push prod in 3h.

deploy-bot: Production deploy succeeded (deploy-4829).

sara-partnerships: Confirmed — prod portal accepted PO 98012345. Customer notified and green for launch. Closing the escalation. Will open a follow-up ticket for engineering to normalize timezone handling in portal (ticket INT-5772).

maria-legal: Leaving note in contract tracker about temporary config change.

jeff-sales: Thanks all — great cross-team move. Sara, can you add a brief postmortem in partnerships channel with timeline + recommended permanent fixes?

sara-partnerships: Will do. Short postmortem coming in partnerships later today.
